tex_content.label: compuniq
tex_content.html:
(Hamilton, cf. \cite{Hamilton3MPRC}.) Let $(M,g_0)$ be a compact Riemannian manifold of dimension $n$.

  1. There is a $T>0$ depending on $(M,g_0)$ and a Ricci flow $(M,g(t)),\ 0\le t<T$, with $g(0)=g_0$.

  2. Suppose that we have Ricci flows with initial conditions $(M,g_0)$ at time $0$ defined respectively on time intervals $I$ and $I'$. Then these flows agree on $I\cap I'$.
